properties.title: Chandrayaan-2 CLASS L2 Elemental Abundance Map - Sodium
properties.lri:data_use_note: Na wt% derived from CLASS X-ray fluorescence spectra along sparse orbital ground tracks at a fixed 150 km (along-track) x 12.5 km (across-track) ground pixel size, consistent with the Al/Fe/Mg/Si release (Narendranath et al. 2024b). Na is a volatile-related element mobilized by processes such as photodesorption and meteoritic impact into the lunar exosphere; CLASS observations show an increasing Na trend towards the poles, supporting this model. The Na K-alpha XRF line is weak, giving Na the sparsest coverage of the five CLASS elements.
properties.lri:quality_note: Coverage is 5.45% of the grid (2021-04-01 to 2022-05-31), well below the ~22% of Al/Fe/Mg/Si, reflecting the weaker Na XRF line. Pixels outside CLASS ground tracks carry no measurement and are stored as NoData rather than interpolated. L2 retrievals require elevated solar X-ray activity, which is why coverage is track-shaped rather than a filled global grid.
properties.measurement_depth: tens of microns (X-ray fluorescence escape depth, true surface), much shallower than gamma-ray/neutron spectrometer techniques
properties.processing:lineage: Original Float32 GeoTIFF (ch2_cla_l2_map_na_v1.tif) has its CRS tag reassigned from EPSG:4326 to IAU:30100 via gdal_translate (same numeric lon/lat grid, corrected body reference), NoData explicitly set to 0, and is written as COG with DEFLATE/PREDICTOR=3 compression.
